subject.title: fix(webchat): preserve session context on first send after page load (#96331)

question: Should WebChat treat a successfully loaded history session as a one-shot resume signal that can preserve the displayed session across idle/daily freshness on the next send?
rationale: That choice changes session freshness behavior for existing WebChat users and is separate from the mechanical rebase/port work needed for this conflicting branch.

options.title: Accept Loaded-History Continuity
options.body: Port the fix to the current chat modules and keep the private marker behavior so displayed history and first follow-up send stay aligned.

options.title: Keep Reset-First Semantics
options.body: Reject the loaded-history resume behavior and instead design a stale-session disclosure or restore UX where idle/daily reset wins.

recommendation.title: Accept Loaded-History Continuity
recommendation.body: Port the fix to the current chat modules and keep the private marker behavior so displayed history and first follow-up send stay aligned.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged WebChat session-continuity contract that this policy decision extends.
